note: Fixed Nanakshahi dates repeat every year. Entries with "varies": true follow the Bikrami lunar calendar and shift annually — the date shown is the one the source listed, so confirm it against that year's panjika. Nothing here is computed or guessed.

days.name: Guru Gobind Singh Ji Parkash Utsav
days.note: The birth of the tenth Guru.

days.name: Mela Maghi
days.note: Honours the forty Muktas who fell with Guru Gobind Singh at Khidrane di Dhab.

days.name: Sikh New Year
days.note: The first day of the Nanakshahi calendar, 1 Chet.

days.name: Hola Mohalla
days.note: Guru Gobind Singh's gathering of martial display at Anandpur Sahib, the day after Holi.

days.name: Vaisakhi · Khalsa Sajna Diwas
days.note: The founding of the Khalsa by Guru Gobind Singh at Anandpur Sahib.

days.name: Shaheedi Diwas · Guru Arjan Dev Ji
days.note: The martyrdom of the fifth Guru at Lahore.

days.name: Pahila Prakash Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji
days.note: Marks the Guru Granth Sahib as the eternal Guru.

days.name: Bandi Chhor Divas
days.note: The release of Guru Hargobind and the fifty-two princes from Gwalior Fort.

days.name: Guru Nanak Dev Ji Gurpurab
days.note: The birth of Guru Nanak at Nankana Sahib.

days.name: Shaheedi Diwas · Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji
days.note: The martyrdom of the ninth Guru at Chandni Chowk, Delhi.

days.name: Shaheedi · Vadde Sahibzade
days.note: Ajit Singh and Jujhar Singh, at the battle of Chamkaur.

days.name: Shaheedi · Chhote Sahibzade
days.note: Zorawar Singh and Fateh Singh, at Sirhind.
